text:
Sara (CEO): Quick exec pulse before weekend — three callouts and a few asks.
Sara (CEO): Callout A: Data residency toggle lands next week for EU & APAC Private deployments. Legal/Ops, confirm wording and telemetry gating by Mon 18:00 UTC.
Sara (CEO): Callout B: New internal policy — hosted default logs retention = 90d; enterprise 365d opt-in. Renee to publish short legal note and customer-facing FAQ.
Sara (CEO): Callout C: Incident recap: yesterday	we saw degraded routing for a small peer group after the routing table update; auto-fallback routed 12% of flows to lower-capacity replicas for ~22m. No data loss. Jon to post postmortem.
Sara (CEO): Metrics snapshot: hosted p95 118ms, p99 390ms (impacted during incident), error rate 0.82% (target <0.5%). Dedicated numbers steady.
Sara (CEO): Asks — 1) Adele/Clara: customer note + 1-pager for sales by Tue 10:00. 2) Vikram/Jon: finalize routing rollback and add canary gate for routing-table changes. 3) Miles: run token-burst cost sim for the residency toggle (how much incremental infra spend).

Vikram (VP Ops): Ack. We're adding a safety gate on routing commits: requires successful canary at 1% traffic for 15m before full push. Will post PR.

Vikram (VP Ops): Canary enforcement snippet we will add to CI:
```bash
# canary deploy check
curl -fsS http://canary-check/api/status || exit 1
sleep 900 # 15m
```

Renee (Head Legal): Working on the retention FAQ and the residency text. Will include export, deletion, and audit items. ETA Mon 16:00 UTC.

Jon (SRE): Incident quick notes: root cause = missing route delta in the reconciler when node labels changed; fallback worked but overwhelmed small replicas. Mitigation: add idempotent route apply + backpressure on replica spin-up.

Jon (SRE): Commands we ran during mitigation:
```bash
kubectl apply -f routing-patch.yaml --record
kubectl scale deploy infer-replica --replicas=4
```
Full postmortem tomorrow.

Adele (Product): I'll prepare the customer-facing copy and the UI flag text. Recommend adding a short banner in the console for impacted customers during rollout.

Miles (Finance): I'll run three burn scenarios for residency: minimal (5% extra infra), medium (12%), heavy (25%). Need expected qtr usage forecast from Product. Adele, can you share numbers?

Clara (Comms): I'll draft the one-pager and seat it with Sales/CS. First cut Mon 09:00.

deploy-bot: deployment triggered for `residency-toggle` (commit 7c4b1a) by @Vikram — ETA ~30m.

Sara (CEO): Thanks team. I'll mention this in Monday all-hands with two bullets: (1) residency toggle + retention policy, (2) routing canary added. Ping me directly for any blocker. :handshake:
